title: Revoked API key used
description: A revoked key was presented to the API. Either an integration was not updated, or someone holds a copy of a key that was revoked for a reason.

mitre.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token

false_positives: A forgotten integration still configured with the old key after a planned rotation.
tuning: If the key was revoked during an incident, escalate any use immediately.
